name: kitchen-table
description: The site is static (GitHub Pages serves this directory as-is). This file exists only so the Render service — which runs `yarn` then `yarn start` from the repo root — installs and starts the import server in backend/ without any settings changes.

scripts.postinstall: bash -c 'if [ -n "${RENDER:-}" ]; then cd backend && npm install && bash get-tools.sh; fi'
